title: Backgrounds generation
author: BugaiGames
selftext:
How do you create backgrounds (non pixel art)? Both floor and backstage - or im getting too generic mess, or great image in location style BUT it cannot be used as bg due amount of noise it creates and in general doesnt feel like proper floor/bg asset.

Any help with maybe prompt ideas or postprocessing?

comments.author: Upset-Basil4459
comments.body: Try asking GPT to craft a prompt for you, you can also ask it to ask you questions to help you craft exactly what you want

replies.author: BugaiGames
replies.body: I past 10 iterations exactly doing that, so far didnt worked. It results in one of two outcomes so far(empty or noisy). Trying to understand others experience and figure out what im doing wrong

replies.author: Upset-Basil4459
replies.body:
What do you think of this:

Create a classic JRPG battle background in a non-pixel-art style, inspired by the PS1 era and the look and feel of Final Fantasy IX. The scene takes place outdoors on lush green plains, with a wide grassy battlefield in the foreground that provides clear open space for characters to stand and fight in a side-view JRPG battle layout.



In the midground and distance, show a beautiful natural landscape with rolling green fields, a forest nearby, and mountains in the distance under a bright, clear midday sky. The overall mood should feel heroic, nostalgic, and beautiful, evoking the charm of a classic fantasy adventure.



The setting should be medieval fantasy, with a visual style reminiscent of Final Fantasy-style world design, but with no visible civilization: no towns, ruins, roads, castles, or man-made structures. Keep the environment fully natural and suitable for battles against many different enemy types.



Use a straight-on camera angle and compose the image like a traditional side-view JRPG battle screen background. The artwork should feel like a painted PS1-era RPG background, detailed and atmospheric, but not photorealistic and not pixel art.

https://preview.redd.it/zciifr3oln2h1.png?width=1448&format=png&auto=webp&s=3db45bd4a703f3a6d6215a95561a7338a4030fb8

replies.author: BugaiGames
replies.body: Wow! That exactly what I was failing to achieve!! Thanks for advice, i will try to iterate those!!

replies.author: Upset-Basil4459
replies.body:
The important thing to know is that I got ChatGPT to make the prompt for me. I simply answered some questions and then copy-pasted that prompt. Here's what I asked GPT in order to get the prompt:

Help me draft up a battle background for a classic RPG (non-pixel art). Ask me some questions to answer and then draft up a prompt to give to an image generator AI

It made me answer about 15 questions and then wrote up that prompt which I then used to generate an image.
